description: Find POFA tournaments (tennis & pickleball) by keyword, city, or start date. Returns each event's id, name and one-line summary. Start here whenever the user wants to discover, browse or pick an event; follow with get_tournament for one event's full details. Read-only, no credentials needed.

city.description: City filter, matched against the event's location text

date_from.description: Only events starting on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

query.description: Keyword matched against the event name

name: search_tournaments
